bars.doubts: RH: the flat is printed only before the beat-1 E5 (bowl in the E5 space); Eb5 carries to beats 2-4 (no accidental on those E's). A single sharp before beat 2, centred on the F5 line: F#5, carried to beat 4 (Eb5/F#5 printed as a displaced second). LH beat 2: one sharp on the F3 line (not two). Beats 3-4: descending octaves D-C-Bb-A (passing bass under D7(b9), leading to G in bar 25).

Naturals on RH F6, F5 (beat 1), E6 (beat 4) and LH F4 (beat 3) are courtesy naturals after bar 24's F#/Eb; pitches are plain F and E. Middle half note has no accidental: Bb5. Three ties (F6, Bb5, F5) from the half-note chord into the beat-3 eighth chord.

Flat before the first RH chord: its bowl fills the D6 space between the E6 and C6 ledger lines, so Db6 (carried to the beat-2.5 and beat-4 chords). RH upper structure is borrowed iv (Bbm(maj7) -> Bbm6) over a C7 LH arpeggio; the RH F6 sounds against LH E3, as printed. Four ties (G6, F6, Db6, Bb5) from the dotted-quarter chord to the beat-4 quarter chord.

First chord's top note sits above the A5 ledger line (ledger at the notehead's bottom edge, notehead centre in the Bb5 space): Bb5, an appoggiatura resolving to A5 (ledger through the notehead) in the tied chord, like bar 23's G->F. Three ties (A5, E5, C5).
